title: Reviewer checklist (tier-aware: 2nd reviewer / back-translation / clinician)
context: Translated packs are draft-only until a qualified-speaker sign-off is recorded, with tier-dependent gates: an independent second reviewer for Tier B/C, a back-translation record for every Tier-C phrase, and clinician sign-off for medical-critical Tier-C phrases. The reviewer checklist operationalizes those gates. It depends on the criticality rubric.
objective: Write the tier-aware reviewer checklist covering second-reviewer, back-translation, and clinician-sign-off gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist enforces qualified-speaker sign-off independent of drafting, with a COI declaration
Requires an independent second reviewer for Tier B/C and a back-translation record for every Tier-C phrase
Requires clinician/medical-interpreter sign-off for medical-critical Tier-C phrases
Requires that all agent UNCERTAIN: flags are captured in review.yaml and that no sign-off occurs while any flag is unresolved
Verifies mandatory disclaimer, attribution, provenance, and verified locale data are present
